response.why: Attack-all (68): Deal 3 damage (Spyglass Siren 1 + Faerie Mastermind 2) and reduce opponent to 16 life. Floodpits Drowner has summoning sickness so can't attack. This maintains aggressive clock pressure—in the mirror, being the beatdown is key. Both your flying creatures tap, but the opponent's Faerie Mastermind is also tapped and summoning sick, so they have limited threats next turn. Hold[Spyglass Siren] (55) is safer but only deals 2 damage. Hold[Faerie Mastermind] (50) deals just 1 damage. No attack (40) concedes all momentum.

You've established a strong board (upgraded 3/5 Preacher, multiple fliers) and should press your advantage. Holding back creatures is too passive—you're the beatdown here with 4 untapped creatures vs opponent's 2 (one tapped, one with summoning sickness). Unblocked deals 5 damage and leaves Drowner untapped for future plays. Even if blocked for 3 damage, that's solid progress from 16 life toward the win.
